# caputchin_site_key (Data Source)

Look up an existing Caputchin site key by id. The secret is never returned by this data source; it is only available at creation time on the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "caputchin_site_key" "existing" {
  id = "site_abc123"
}

output "site_public_key" {
  value = data.caputchin_site_key.existing.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Site identifier.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the site key is disabled.
- `key` (String) Public site key embedded in the widget.
- `name` (String) Human-readable site name.
- `tier` (String) Plan tier inherited from the owning troop.
- `troop_id` (String) Owning troop identifier.
